_meta.note: Every beat = one unique image + one unique clip. No beat repeats. Clips are generated in beat order.

beats.description: Animated title card: 'Sunny and the Crew' logo appears on warm yellow background with sunburst animation
Wide shot of sunny neighborhood street. Establishing world. Bright, safe, colorful.
Sunny jumping with joy, fists raised, eyes closed in pure happiness. Peak theme energy.
Sunny running down sidewalk toward camera — coming to meet the audience. End of theme song.
Sunny faces camera directly, bright background, warm smile. She greets the audience: 'Hey Crew! It's me, Sunny! Something happened today that made me think.'
beats.prompt_notes: Sunny facing directly into camera, warm yellow-gradient background, big warm smile, slightly leaning forward, engaged and friendly. Direct address pose.
beats.dialog_cue: Hey Crew! It's me, Sunny! And today — something happened that made me think.

beats.description: Leo sits in the backyard holding a broken toy rocket ship. He looks sad and frustrated. Mia stands nearby looking worried.
beats.prompt_notes: Leo sitting cross-legged on green grass in a bright backyard, holding broken toy rocket (two pieces, snapped in half), sad expression, slumped shoulders. Mia stands nearby with a worried expression. Sunny in background. Bright afternoon light. 3D Pixar-style.
beats.dialog_cue: Leo has his rocket ship — and it's broken. Oh no!

beats.description: Sunny on porch steps, hands on cheeks, curious and thinking expression. She's noticing Leo's sadness and wondering what to do.
beats.dialog_cue: Leo looks really sad. I wonder... does he need help?

beats.description: Sunny faces camera, taps her chin with one finger, knowing smile. She's about to share the secret. This is the turning point beat — builds into the song.
beats.prompt_notes: Sunny facing directly into camera, tapping chin with one finger (thinking pose), sly knowing smile, pigtails bouncing slightly, bright warm background. Playful and confident. 'I know a secret' energy.
beats.music_cue: MUSIC_EP01_SONG fade in at end of beat
beats.dialog_cue: Asking for help — is actually REALLY brave. Want to hear a song about it?

beats.description: Song starts. Sunny arms wide open on the street, huge welcoming smile. Bright, energetic, visual song launch.
Verse 1 begins. Leo looking at his broken rocket, hesitant, not sure what to do. Visual: 'Sometimes you don't know what to do...'
beats.prompt_notes: Close-up of Leo's face, looking down at broken rocket in his hands, biting his lip nervously, uncertain expression. Soft warm backyard light. Gentle, emotional framing. 3D Pixar-style.

beats.description: Sunny walks toward Leo, noticing his sadness, gentle and encouraging expression.
beats.prompt_notes: Sunny walking across backyard toward camera with a gentle, caring expression. She's walking toward Leo (off-camera). Warm afternoon light. 3D Pixar-style. Soft footsteps energy.

beats.scene: Song Chorus 1 — HERO SHOT: Raise Your Hand!
beats.description: CHORUS PEAK. Sunny raising hand confidently in the classroom. THE hero image for this song. Bright, energetic, this is the 'Ask Ask Ask!' visual.
Chorus continues. Sunny jumping with fists raised in pure joy. Energy is at max during chorus.
Verse 2. Mia kneels beside Leo and shows him how to fix the rocket. Leo watches carefully. Gentle, collaborative scene.
beats.prompt_notes: Mia kneeling beside Leo in the backyard, pointing at the broken rocket pieces, explaining something with a gentle smile. Leo watching carefully, starting to look hopeful. Warm afternoon backyard light. 3D Pixar-style.

beats.description: Leo raises his hand! He's asking for help now — brave, proud, empowered. Turning point of the episode.
beats.prompt_notes: Leo standing in the backyard, right arm raised confidently, big proud smile, glasses glinting in the sunlight. His posture is tall and brave. This mirrors Sunny's classroom raising-hand shot. 3D Pixar-style.

beats.description: Second chorus. Sunny, Leo, and Mia all together, arms up celebrating. The crew! The rocket is fixed.
beats.prompt_notes: Sunny, Leo, and Mia standing together in the backyard, all three with arms raised in celebration, big smiles. Leo holds the FIXED rocket ship high above his head. Sunny on left, Leo center, Mia on right. Confetti/sparkle effect in air. 3D Pixar-style. Peak joy.

beats.description: Chorus continues. Sunny running toward camera full of energy and joy.
Song winds down. Sunny on porch, calm and happy. Peaceful neighborhood. The lesson has landed.
Song ends. Sunny faces camera directly, warm and proud. 'Did you hear that? Asking for help is BRAVE!'
beats.prompt_notes: Sunny facing directly into camera, both arms slightly raised in celebration, huge warm smile, pigtails bouncy. Proud and celebratory energy. Direct address. Bright warm background. 3D Pixar-style.
beats.dialog_cue: Did you hear that? Asking for help is BRAVE!

beats.description: Sunny leads a call-and-response. She holds hand to ear waiting for audience response.
beats.prompt_notes: Sunny leaning slightly toward camera, one hand cupped behind ear in 'I'm listening!' pose, eyebrows raised waiting for an answer, playful expression, bright background. 3D Pixar-style.
beats.dialog_cue: Can you say it with me? I — can — ask — for — help! Say it louder! I — can — ask — for — help!

beats.description: Sunny claps with the rhythm. Movement moment — audience claps along.
beats.prompt_notes: Sunny clapping hands together in rhythm, smiling and bobbing slightly, joyful and energetic, looking at camera. Bright background. 3D Pixar-style.
beats.dialog_cue: Let's clap it out! (clap) Ask! (clap) Ask! (clap) Ask!

beats.description: Quick beat: Leo proudly holds up the fixed rocket. He asked for help and it worked! Huge smile.
beats.prompt_notes: Leo standing in backyard, holding fixed toy rocket high above his head with both hands, beaming smile, glasses catching sunlight, posture tall and proud. Celebratory energy. 3D Pixar-style.
beats.dialog_cue: And guess what Leo did? He asked Mia for help. And she knew exactly how to fix it!

beats.description: Sunny faces camera with confident warmth. Delivers the final lesson line directly.
beats.prompt_notes: Sunny facing directly into camera, slight tilt of head, warm confident smile, one finger pointing gently toward the viewer. 'You're smart enough to ask.' energy. Bright warm background. 3D Pixar-style.
beats.dialog_cue: So next time you need help — what do you do? That's right. You ASK.

beats.description: LOCKED OUTRO. Sunny waving goodbye from the porch. Theme music sting. End of episode.
beats.dialog_cue: Thank you for watching with me today, Crew! Remember — asking for help is brave. You are brave. See you next time! Bye bye!

summary.note_on_B01: B01 is a title card — this may be created as a static graphic rather than a Higgsfield generation
